items.q: Curly Russell. Sonny Rollins. We played uptown; somebody had a joint up there.

items.title: 68004_Howard McGhee oral history interview
items.q: Curley Russell on bass, I think -- I'm pretty sure it was. And Fats and I and Ernie Henry.

ctx.x: Milt Jackson on piano. Curley Russell on bass, I think -- I'm pretty sure it was. And Fats and I and Ernie Henry. It came out pretty good. The two trumpets was the main issue there anyway. Which I'm grateful that it came out that good.
